# Chuck the File Changer

Chuck the File Changer performs large-scale file page text changes from manual
lists, Quarry result sets, and VisualFileChange-style source discovery. It is
designed for Commons file pages and defaults to dry-run previews.

The module is scoped to `commons.wikimedia.org` and uses a module-specific
user-agent for Quarry requests and Pywikibot edits. Set
`CHUCK_FILE_CHANGER_USER_AGENT` only if a deployment needs to override the
default identity.

Runs are stored in the module-owned `chuck_file_change_jobs` and
`chuck_file_change_job_items` tables. Large target sets are chunked into one
job row per chunk, and the shared Celery worker executes
`buckbot.process_chuck_file_change_job` for each queued row. Redis stores
best-effort progress snapshots under `chuck_file_changer:job:<id>`.
The module creates these tables automatically through the framework database
connection before it reads or queues work. The UI's **Job table** section
shows the most recent durable job rows (your own runs, or all runs for module
managers), including failed runs and their status.

## Sources

Manual targets can be one title per line:

```text
File:Example.jpg
Example2.jpg|Uploader|Optional note
```

Quarry sources can be a query URL, run URL, query ID, `query:ID`, or `run:ID`.
The result must include a recognizable title column such as `img_name`,
`page_title`, `file_title`, `file`, or `title`.

VFC-style sources are resolved through the Commons API before chunking:

- `user`: uploader uploads from `list=logevents`, including re-uploads. Both
  `ExampleUser` and `User:ExampleUser` are accepted.
- `category`: file members from `list=categorymembers`.
- `page`: images used on a page or gallery from `prop=images`.
- `search`: file namespace search from `list=search`.

Uploader, category, and page/gallery fields offer Commons-backed completions as
you type. User suggestions query `allusers`, category suggestions query
`allcategories`, and page/gallery suggestions query `prefixsearch`.

## Operations

- `replace`: exact text replacement.
- `replace` with `use_regex`: regular-expression replacement.
- `prepend`: add text before existing page text.
- `append`: add text after existing page text.

Custom edit summaries support `%FULLPAGENAME%`, `%FULLPAGENAMEE%`,
`%PAGENAME%`, and `%SUMMARY_HINT%`.

Always preview before applying. The apply endpoint requires
`module:chuck_file_changer:apply_changes` or `module:chuck_file_changer:manage`.

## Authz

The manifest declares these module rights:

- `module:chuck_file_changer:view`: generated by the framework; lets a user open
  the module UI when granted directly or through module access.
- `module:chuck_file_changer:estop`: generated by the framework for emergency
  stops.
- `module:chuck_file_changer:manage`: manage-level module access.
- `module:chuck_file_changer:run_jobs`: run configured module jobs.
- `module:chuck_file_changer:edit_config`: edit module runtime configuration.
- `module:chuck_file_changer:apply_changes`: use the live apply endpoint.

The custom module API enforces authz itself:

- `GET /chuck_file_changer/api/auth` returns the current module capabilities.
- `POST /chuck_file_changer/api/targets/parse` requires module access.
- `POST /chuck_file_changer/api/quarry/url` requires module access.
- `POST /chuck_file_changer/api/preview` requires module access and forces a
  dry run job to be queued.
- `POST /chuck_file_changer/api/apply` requires
  `module:chuck_file_changer:apply_changes` or
  `module:chuck_file_changer:manage` and queues a live apply job.
- `GET /chuck_file_changer/api/jobs/<run_id>` returns module job status,
  Redis progress, target item rows, and final results for this module.
- `GET /chuck_file_changer/api/jobs` returns durable run-history rows; regular
  users see only their own rows and module managers see all rows.
- `GET /chuck_file_changer/api/source-suggestions` returns context-sensitive
  Commons completions for uploader, category, and page/gallery fields.

Example grant configuration:

```json
{
  "alice": [
    "module:chuck_file_changer:view",
    "module:chuck_file_changer:apply_changes"
  ]
}
```
